description_en:
Translates documents between more than 100 language pairs (including bridged pairs), supporting multi-scenario, multi-page, and highly complex document translation. Scanned documents are not currently supported. Excels in the following areas:
- Content accuracy: translation accuracy, parameter and unit accuracy
- Structural integrity: overall layout continuity, page margin and layout preservation
description_zh:
专为文档翻译研发，支持100多种(含桥接)语向之间的互译，满足多场景&多页数&高复杂度文档翻译，暂不支持扫描件。
在以下方面表现出色：
- 内容准确性：翻译准确性，参数与单位准确性
- 结构合理性：整体排版连续性，页面边距与布局还原性
kebab_example: aliyun aidge document-translate --url https://aib-innovation-oss.oss-accelerate.aliyuncs.com/AI_Business/38dao/testdemo.pdf0Expires=3356578313_OSSAccessKeyId=LTAI5tE8X3gEy66SRU1V8dig_Signature=8niQY2HtMQY7h05zmSUdyORML9E%3D --target-language en --file-type PDF --glossary glossary_1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DocumentTranslate

parameters.help_en: The OSS URL path of the document to be translated
parameters.help_zh: 待翻译文档的OSS URL路径
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: The target language. The language code uses the two-letter ISO 639-1 standard
parameters.help_zh: 目标语向，语言代码采用ISO639-1标准的两位字母表示法
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The supported document types: PDF or Word. Size limits: Word 200 MB/300 pages, PDF 200 MB/300 pages, maximum 200 MB per file
parameters.help_zh: 支持文档的类型：PDF/word。容量限制：word 200MB/300页，PDF 200MB/300页，单个文件最大200MB
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en: The glossary ID to use when the glossary feature is required. Supports custom translation results, including do-not-translate (ABC-ABC), specified translation (ABC-DEF), and skip translation (ABC-empty value). Commonly used for brand name protection scenarios
parameters.help_zh: 需要干预功能时填写干预词表ID。支持自定义翻译结果，包含不被翻译（ABC-ABC），指定翻译（ABC-DEF），不翻译（ABC-空值），常用于品牌词保护等场景
parameters.name: glossary
